headlines.title: Anthropic adds support for the AGENTS.md instructions spec to Claude Code; OpenAI contributed AGENTS.md to the Agentic AI Foundation last year (Thomas Claburn/The Register)
Raindrop, which develops tech for monitoring AI agents to catch failures such as hallucinations and tool misuse, raised a $35M Series A led by CRV (Chris Metinko/Axios)
A look at AI safety groups METR, Redwood Research, and Apollo Research, as AI misalignment incidents at OpenAI and Anthropic thrust them into the spotlight (Hayden Field/The Verge)
Business intelligence startup Veridion, which develops an AI-powered, real-time map of ~640M businesses worldwide, raised a $20M Series A led by Hoxton Ventures (Tamara Djurickovic/Tech.eu)
A startup that builds other startups raised $100M and is all-in on physical AI
Irregular told four AI labs in late July that their models had breached systems during its tests. The public learned in stages, and Google went last.
Three researchers used Claude to reach OpenAI’s internal code. OpenAI paid $6,500 and closed the hole in 14 hours.
Vantora, formerly UP.Labs, which builds AI-native startups designed to solve problems for corporate customers, raised $100M+ from Silversmith Capital Partners (Kirsten Korosec/TechCrunch)
Nex, which makes Nex Playground, raised a $150M Series E; Nex has sold 1M units of the motion-based gaming system targeted toward kids since its launch in 2023 (Sophie McEvoy/GamesIndustry.biz)
Twin tech founders who left Seattle for Alaska bet on an AI agent named ‘Walter’ to cover local news
UK Sovereign AI Fund in talks to back £500m raise for drug discovery startup
Open or closed AI? Nvidia’s Nader Khalil and Sydney Sykes take on one of the decisions shaping next-gen startups at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
Inside Temporal’s journey to a $12.55B valuation, and its bet on building a backbone for AI agents
What 25,000 Startup Applications Reveal About The New Rules Of Seed-Stage Startups
How OpenAI Used Its Own LLMs to Design Its Jalapeño Chip
Meta’s CTO says the glasses problem is a small number of bad actors. His company is reportedly about to launch a version without a camera.
OpenAI told investors in February its compute bill would be around $600bn. A July presentation puts it at $856bn.
Trump and Xi already talked AI guardrails once this year. Nothing was signed, and no chips shipped.
OpenAI and Microsoft knew they were starting a ‘doom loop’ for the web
Y Combinator insurance tech alum Angle Health hits $2.7B valuation
Tech Moves: Ascend promotes Nate Bek; Microsoft Word ‘Agent Mode’ architect exits; TAF names new exec
A new kind of AI model from a ChatGPT inventor is thrilling developers
The Week’s 10 Biggest Funding Rounds: Large Rounds For AI Infrastructure, Space Tech And Investment Management Lead
